column3: ## Test Publisher Comments on New Applications and Update Requests
Setup: Navigate to /testdrive/publisher_comment
Setup: At the top of the Testdrive page, the test title is shown followed by its ID, e.g. 'TestName (id: 234)'.
Setup: Usernames and record titles follow the `name__id` format. When the test says to log in as User__<id>, use the test ID, e.g. User__123.
Setup: During the test, you may see multiple records or users with the same name. Always select the one that matches your test ID.
Setup: All data in the Testdrive dashboard includes a copy button. You can use it to quickly copy the correct value and use it in the relevant place in the test.
Setup: Open a new session in a different browser or a private (incognito) window. Do not close the Testdrive page.
Log in as QuillMartin__<id> (publisher) using the credentials provided in Testdrive (use "Log in with password" option)

column4: The publisher dashboard is displayed

column3: Open the "My applications" tab and click "Edit" for the draft application Journal of Nocturnal Pollination Studies__<id>. Alternatively, open the URL provided under publisher -> new_application in the Testdrive

column4: The pre-filled application form for Journal of Nocturnal Pollination Studies__<id> is displayed

column3: Select step 7, "Review", from the side navigation and scroll to the bottom of the page

column4: An optional additional comment field is displayed above the confirmation checkbox
A character counter is displayed in the lower-right corner of the field

column3: Enter the comment provided under publisher -> new_application -> comment in Testdrive

column4: The character counter updates to show the current number of characters

column3: Try to enter enough additional text to exceed the 200-character limit. Alternatively, paste the value provided under publisher -> new_application -> comment_extension

column4: The field does not accept more than 200 characters
If pasted text would cause the content to exceed 200 characters, only the portion that fits within the limit is inserted
The character counter does not exceed 200

column3: Select the confirmation checkbox and click "Submit"

column4: The application is submitted successfully

column3: Return to the publisher dashboard and open the "Update requests" tab
Click "Edit" for International Review of Applied Hibernation__<id>. Alternatively, open the URL provided under publisher -> update_request -> url

column4: The pre-filled update request form for International Review of Applied Hibernation__<id> is displayed

column3: Select step 7 "Review" from the side navigation and scroll to the bottom of the page

column4: An optional additional comment field is displayed above the confirmation checkbox

column3: Enter a comment in the field or paste the comment provided under publisher -> update_request -> comment in Testdrive

column4: The comment is displayed in the field
The character counter updates to show the current number of characters

column3: Select the confirmation checkbox and click "Submit"

column4: The update request is submitted successfully

column3: Log out of the publisher account
Log in as DrVesperCeleste__<id> (admin) using the credentials provided in Testdrive (use "Log in with password" option)
Open the admin application for Journal of Nocturnal Pollination Studies__<id> using the URL provided under admin -> new_application -> url

column4: The admin application for Journal of Nocturnal Pollination Studies__<id> is displayed
A note created by the publisher is displayed at the top of the notes column
The note contains the same text that the publisher submitted
If the Testdrive comment was used, the note matches the value under admin -> new_application -> comment

column3: Close the form
Open the admin update request form for International Review of Applied Hibernation__<id> using the URL provided under admin -> update_request -> url

column4: The admin update request form for International Review of Applied Hibernation__<id> is displayed
A note created by the publisher is displayed at the top of the notes column
The note contains the same text that the publisher submitted
If the Testdrive comment was used, the note matches the value under admin -> update_request -> comment
